name: Dedham Public Schools Summer Institute
description_short: A district-run summer enrichment program for Dedham children in grades K-5. Families sign up week by week for a morning or afternoon session in areas such as movement, sports, games, cooking, books and crafts. All sessions are held at Avery Elementary School.
refund_policy_summary: Enrollment choices could be changed at no charge until Thursday, April 16, 2026. Invoices were sent to families on May 15, 2026. The page does not give a refund policy.

The page only covers the 2026 season (June 29-July 31, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 information is posted.
The 'full' availability comes from a February 4, 2026 update and only describes the 2026 season.
The program is only open to children living in Dedham, and registration goes through the district's PowerSchool parent portal.
Week 1 is a short 3-day week (July 2-3 off), so it costs $80 per session instead of $135.
Each fee is for one half-day session (morning or afternoon). A full day would mean booking both sessions, about $270 for a standard week.
The phone number is the main district number, not a direct line for the Summer Institute.
